work.author: GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS
work.description: Bull CIII (OCR cy.; GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS servus servorum Dei LF19645–19646) suppresses the nullius jurisdiction of S. Lorenzo in Campo and unites its three towns to Pergola; LF19684 → LF19690 across page number LF19687; LF19749 → LF19758 across own provenance LF19752 and page number 134 LF19755; LF19851 → LF19857 across running title LF19854; LF19927 → LF19933 across running-title part ANNO LF19930; LF19996 → LF20005 across the detached running-title part MDCCCXXXVI, LF19999 (raw heading line-00019999) and page number LF20002; LF20075 → LF20084 across a mark LF20078 and page number 136 LF20081; complete closing dated septimo idus iulii 1836. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS at LF19645–19645; the source closing at LF20088–20091 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem anno incarnationis dominicae millesimo octingentesimo triges'mo sexto, septimo idus iulii pontificatus Nostri anno sexto.’ Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
